notes: In-game 24h clock. Primary source: The Wild Register per-species pages, whose schedules come from TacMaps by TicTactical; gaps filled from the Steam guide 1767037181 where noted. Ranges are copied as the source writes them, including 30-minute overlaps (e.g. 04:00-08:30) that some sources use to show the transition. drink [] = source lists no drink zone for that species (normal for birds, hares and some small game); a null feed/rest means the source gives none. A null species entry means no data was found. Neither source states outright that need zone times are species-wide, but the data shows that most species keep the same schedule in every reserve (e.g. Red Deer is identical in all 6 of its reserves, Red Fox in all 6, Wild Boar in all 4, Moose in 5 of 6, and the Steam guide says all Spanish ibex share one schedule). Exceptions are noted per entry (e.g. Tòrr fallow deer, Medved gray wolf, Intisuyu whitetail/collared peccary/puma, Askiy moose). Schedules can change with game updates (The Wild Register).
